title: Stop at the checkpoint
introduction: Stop at the first coin, or at the wall if no checkpoint exists.
explanation: && means AND: both conditions must be true. In a while condition, frontIsClear() && !beepersPresent() permits a step only if there is space ahead and no coin on the current square.
objective: Reach the first coin without picking it up. If there is no coin, reach the end of the corridor. Always finish facing east with the bag empty.
instruction: Use && in a while condition. Handle a checkpoint at the starting square and a start directly at the wall.

commands.description: True only when both conditions are true.

hints: Stopping has two possible reasons: a coin here or a wall ahead.
The continuation condition must rule out both reasons.
Check for a clear path AND no coin before each move.

illustration.alt: Continue only when both checks hold: the path is clear and this square has no coin. Stop on the checkpoint, without collecting it.
